FIELD_VOLUME_STEP_UP_DOC: How much the volume goes up per scan (1-100).
FIELD_VOLUME_STEP_DOWN_DOC: How much the volume goes down per scan (1-100).
FIELD_PREV_DOC: First scan restarts the track; scan again within 3 seconds for the previous track.
SECTION_LAST_SCANNED_DESC: Hold a tag against the reader, then click 'Edit this tag' below.
FIELD_TRACK_TITLE_DOC: Case, accents and punctuation don't matter. If several tracks have this title, also fill in the artist and/or album.
FIELD_TRACK_URI_DOC: Full path as Volumio knows it, e.g. music-library/NAS/.../track.flac
LAST_SCANNED_NONE: No tag scanned since the last restart.
EDIT_TAG_NONE: First choose a tag above (last scanned, or from the list) to edit it.
ERR_TRACK_AMBIGUOUS: Track is ambiguous ({count} candidates: {names}). Fill in the artist and/or album to choose.
ERR_ALBUM_AMBIGUOUS: Album is ambiguous ({count} candidates: {names}). Fill in the artist to choose.
ERR_TRACK_NO_TITLE: Track: no title or URI in the tag
ERR_ALBUM_NO_NAME: Album: no album name in the tag
ERR_PLAYLIST_EMPTY: Playlist '{name}' is empty or not found
